clusters.headline: Police Negotiate As Armed Men Hold Hostages In Cartagena Supermarket
aiSummaryBullets: Armed assailants have taken a group of people hostage inside a supermarket located in the city of Cartagena.
Local law enforcement agencies have initiated negotiations with the individuals responsible for the situation.

clusters.headline: Colombian President De La Espriella Blames FARC For Car Bomb Attack
aiSummaryBullets: President De la Espriella officially blamed FARC rebels for orchestrating the car bomb explosion.
Initial reports stated at least 23 people were injured, with updated figures noting up to 25 casualties.
